title: Fix failing unit tests in Rust backend across agent and hooks modules
summary: Resolved all failing Rust unit tests (135/135 tests passing): (1) gated Windows-specific quoting subprocess tests under #[cfg(windows)]; (2) synced agent tool policy intersection checks; (3) restored alphabetical per-agent rules loading in compile_primed_system_prompt; (4) clarified cvh-dev complete_task invariant; (5) cleaned up subagent session collection logic.
